Faced with the lack of task-specific labels, a variety of approaches have been developed to find alternative forms of labeled data as substitutes for goldstandard supervision. This is usually done through some form of expert insights in combination with automation. We group the ideas into two main categories: data augmentation which uses task-specific instances to create more of them ( § 4.1) and distant supervision which labels unlabeled data ( § 4.2) including cross-lingual projections ( § 4.3).
